question.text: What total revenue will Nebius Group report for Q3 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves based on Nebius Group N.V.'s (NASDAQ: NBIS) reported total revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026, as published in the company's Q3 2026 earnings release, scheduled for release before market open on November 12, 2026 and posted at https://nebius.com/investor-hub. The resolving value is the total revenue line (labelled "Revenues" in Nebius's recent results tables) for the three months ended September 30, 2026 in the consolidated results of that release, expressed in millions of US dollars (a figure published as "934.5" in a table headed "In USD $ millions", or as $934,500 thousand, resolves as 934.5; if the release reports in thousands, divide by 1,000). The value as first published governs, even if later revised or restated. If the release has not been published by the expected resolution date, resolution waits and resolves to that figure once it is published; if Nebius Group never publishes a total revenue figure for the three months ended September 30, 2026, the question is annulled.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-02: The Nebius investor hub (https://nebius.com/investor-hub) shows no Q3 2026 results yet. It only says Q3 2026 results come out Thursday, November 12, 2026, before market open, with a call at 8:00 a.m. ET. [Nebius investor hub](https://nebius.com/investor-hub)
- 2026-10-30: The newsroom posted the date announcement for the Q3 results and call. [Nebius Newsroom](https://nebius.com/newsroom)
- MarketBeat still shows an estimated date of November 10. That is a guess from past patterns and is overridden by the company's confirmed November 12. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-11-10-nebius-group-nv-stock/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Q3 revenue has not been published, and Nebius gives no quarterly guidance, only full-year figures.
- 2026-08-12: The Q2 shareholder letter "reaffirmed guidance across all metrics" but put no figures in the letter itself; the $3.0 to 3.4B full-year range comes from the call. [Q2 2026 letter, SEC 6-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001513845/000110465926094568/tm2622968d1_ex99-2.htm)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-01: Motley Fool says the stock fell about 36% from a September high. It describes "near $300" falling to "around $250," which conflicts with the roughly $153 to $182 prices reported elsewhere, so treat its price figures with caution. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/01/is-nebius-stock-a-buy-after-its-36-pullback/)
- 2026-10-31: The Nasdaq fell 2.86% as money rotated out of AI stocks. [neuralwire](https://neuralwire.co/articles/risks-of-dependency-on-cloud-based-ai-services-grow-as-data-security-concerns-rise/)
- 2026-10-30: NBIS fell nearly 11% to $153.35 amid concerns over AI cloud capital spending. [GuruFocus](https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9159799/nebius-group-nbis-shares-drop-nearly-11-amid-tech-selloff-on-ai-cloud-expansion-concerns)
- 2026-10-26: CEO Volozh said some capital sources (asset-backed financing, debt markets) are "temporarily closed." He said customer advances should "probably" fund at least 1 GW. Q2 remaining performance obligations were $37.5B and cash was $8.04B. Three customers made up 24%, 21% and 14% of Q2 revenue. The CFO expects more than $9B of prepayments in 2026. [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/26/nebius-ceo-says-company-has-enough-to-build-its-gigawatt-but-admits-that-some-of-the-capital-sources-are-temporarily-closed/)
- 2026-10-22: Nebius signed a $3.5B secured facility with Citi: 364 days, priced at SOFR + 2.75% and stepping up to 3.5%. [Nebius Newsroom](https://nebius.com/newsroom)
- 2026-10-16: Shares fell about 12% to $165.47 in a sector selloff. [GuruFocus](https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9128275/nebius-group-nbis-shares-plunge-nearly-12-amid-sector-selloff-on-october-16-2026)
- 2026-10-08: Nebius reached NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud status on HGX B300. 2026-10-01: it acquired Inferize to strengthen its Token Factory inference product. [Nebius Newsroom](https://nebius.com/newsroom)
- 2026-08-12, from the Q2 letter, the points that matter for Q3:
  - More capacity came online in the US and Europe in the second half of Q2.
  - All Microsoft capacity tranches delivered so far are done.
  - Most new deals are tied to capacity "arriving in late 2026" and "will contribute primarily to 2027 revenue."
  - A short-term capacity deal signed in Q3 goes live in Q4.
  - Capacity for the second Meta deal comes online in early 2027.
  - Q2 capex was about $5.7B.
  - Run-rate revenue was $3.0B at end-June, up from $1.9B at end-March.

  [Q2 letter](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001513845/000110465926094568/tm2622968d1_ex99-2.htm)

## 4. Base rates
- Quarterly revenue history: Q3 2025 $146.1M, Q4 2025 $227.7M, Q1 2026 $399.0M, Q2 2026 $582.3M (from the question background, matching the Q2 letter).
- Quarter-on-quarter growth: +56%, +75%, +46%.
- Run-rate check: the $3.0B end-June run rate works out to about $750M a quarter. If Q3 just held that rate, revenue would be about $750M. Consensus of about $905 to 937M assumes the run rate keeps rising through Q3, to roughly $3.6 to 3.75B annualised on average.
- Applying the recent 46 to 56% quarterly growth to Q2 gives about $850 to 910M.
- Past surprises against consensus: Q3 2025 about -5%, Q4 2025 about -5%, Q1 2026 +6.6%, Q2 2026 about +1%. A ±5% surprise on about $915M is roughly ±$45M.
- Full-year check: guidance of $3.0 to 3.4B leaves $2.02 to 2.42B for H2. If the company lands at the midpoint ($3.2B), Q3 plus Q4 equals about $2.22B.

- Consensus estimates for Q3 2026 revenue:

| Benzinga figures cited by Tickeron | about $937M | |

  Sources: [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/NBIS/earnings/), [Equibles](https://equibles.com/research/nebius-group-nbis-q3-2026-earnings-preview-and-forecast), [Tickeron/X](https://x.com/Tickeron/status/2113627754243440989)
- Prediction markets: I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on Nebius Q3 revenue. The only Kalshi Nebius market is about which words get said on the earnings call. Its contract is dated November 10, which doesn't match the confirmed November 12 date. Prices: "Blackwell" 0.69, "Meta" 0.54, "Neocloud" 0.17. It says nothing about the revenue figure.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-12, pre-market: the Q3 release and 8:00 a.m. ET call. This is the resolving event. [Nebius](https://nebius.com/investor-hub)
- Before then:
  - Results from peers, especially CoreWeave's Q3 report (likely in early to mid November; I did not confirm the date), could shift sentiment but not Nebius's reported number.
  - Any Nebius 8-K/6-K or pre-announcement. None found so far.
- Q3 revenue is already fixed, since the quarter ended September 30. What matters is how fast capacity came online in Q3, which outsiders can't see. The Q2 letter's remark that new deals mostly feed 2027 revenue points to a slower Q3 ramp. Meanwhile, the end-June run rate and the capacity added late in Q2 support at least about $750M.

(a) **Time left:** About 10 days. Results come out before the market opens on November 12, 2026.

(b) **Latest known value:** Q2 2026 revenue was $582.3M, reported August 12, 2026. The end-June run rate was $3.0B, which equals about $750M per quarter.

(c) **If nothing changed:** If the end-June run rate simply held through Q3, revenue would be about $750M.

(d) **If the trend continued:** Recent quarter-on-quarter growth of 46-56% applied to Q2 gives about $850-910M. Consensus is about $905-937M.

(e) **Historical variation:** Quarterly growth has ranged from +46% to +75%. Surprises against consensus have been about ±5-7%, which is roughly ±$45-60M here.

(f) **Expert and market expectations:**
- Consensus estimates:
  - MarketBeat $905.75M.
  - Equibles $904.8M, with its own forecast at $934.5M.
  - Zacks $916.8M, range $885-943M.
  - Benzinga about $937M.
- Prediction markets: there is no market on the revenue figure itself.
- The Q2 letter has some cautionary notes:
  - New deals mostly feed 2027 revenue.
  - The Q3 short-term deal goes live only in Q4.
  - The full-year guidance low end allows a Q3 near $800M.
- These lead me to put the median slightly below the higher consensus figures.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** Delays in energizing capacity or customer deployments keep Q3 near the exit run rate, around $750-800M. That would be a miss of more than 10%.
- **High:** Capacity added late in Q2 plus faster activation in Q3 pushes the average run rate above $4B, giving more than $1B.
